column1: # The share of world supply of a commodity that passes a strait, and how much of that flow can avoid it when the strait is shut.
# chokepoint: a ChokepointId. commodity: a CommodityId. littoral: the governments on its shores, space-separated.
# share: 0..1 of world supply. bypass: 0..1 of the strait's own flow that a pipeline or a sea detour can carry instead.
# basis: the arithmetic from the figures on the page. source: the pages read. opened: the day they were read.
# A strait with no row has no sourced flow or no sourced bypass, and so no price effect: Malacca, Suez, Panama and the
# Turkish and Danish straits have flows on the EIA page but no capacity for their alternatives, and are left out.
